text:
alex (sales): heads-up — Acme POC failing intermittently on our private host. They see TLS handshake errors and a few 502s during load.
lisa (acct): from customer: dns resolves to the interface IP, but their app logs show 'tls: certificate not yet valid' and occasional connection resets.
jamal (eng-networks): can you grab a curl -v + the FQDN? also ask them to tcpdump the ENI during a failure window. my hunch: NAT egress churn / conntrack exhaustion.
alex (sales): FQDN: acme-test.private.redwood.internal. curl shows 'SSL certificate problem: certificate is not yet valid' when hitting 10.6.3.14.
marta (eng-runtime): our edge shows repeated 'tls handshake failed' and some 429s flagged by per-source rate limiting around the same times.
jamal (eng-networks): please have them run: sudo conntrack -L | wc -l ; sysctl net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max ; netstat -tan | grep TIME_WAIT | wc -l. also run: openssl s_client -connect 10.6.3.14:443 -servername acme-test.private.redwood.internal -status
acme-ops (customer): quick check: conntrack around 65k (we're at 65536 cap). we'll bump nf_conntrack_max now and retest.
sam (eng-oncall): we can temporarily relax per-src rate trimming for their trial or whitelist their egress CIDR for the POC. ops security signoff needed.
lisa (acct): if we need to avoid shared edge entirely, what's the rough cost for a 2-week dedicated sandbox for POC? customer asked.
marta (eng-runtime): short answer: we can spin a small dedicated pool and pro-rate usage; sending estimate to Alex DM for negotiation (POC credit possible).
jamal (eng-networks): long-term fix: PrivateLink (Interface VPC Endpoint) removes NAT churn and preserves SNI. If they can create an endpoint, we'll provide service name and whitelist ENI.
infra-bot: deploy: private-endpoint-edge launched in zone-b (ips:10.6.3.14,10.6.3.15). cert managed by Redwood, OCSP stapling enabled, expires 2025-02-02T00:00:00Z.
acme-ops (customer): bumped conntrack to 200k; retest shows 2k rps for 10min with no TLS errors. looks stable.
alex (sales): great — marking blocker resolved for demo. we'll follow up on PrivateLink & pricing for prod hardening.
lisa (acct): security folks asked about cert rotation/ocsp for questionnaire. marta, can you paste a blurb?
marta (eng-runtime): blurb: "Redwood manages TLS termination for hosted private endpoints; certificates are rotated proactively, OCSP stapling is enabled, and audit logs for rotation events are available for enterprise customers. Customer-provided certs supported on Private/Dedicated deployments."
sam (eng-oncall): next steps: keep thread open for PrivateLink setup if they proceed; infra will whitelist POC egress CIDR temporarily.
alex (sales): thanks all — excellent triage :rocket:
